The binders themselves exhibit soft, melted top edges and a general lack of crisp geometric definition typical of AI-generated low-resolution images. While some blur may be compression-related, the structural incoherence of the foreground elements and the edge bleeding lower the artifact score significantly below the reference 'mid' quality.
